method_note: Codes were described to the interpreter by their FIRING DISTRIBUTION only (n, top position, number of positions occupied, purity vs base rate). The interpreter was never shown the ground-truth label. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: the prompt also listed candidate arithmetic conditions, including 'a column where the two digits sum to exactly 9'. Code 6's match is therefore partly selection from a supplied menu, not unprompted identification. A raw-firing version without any candidate list supersedes this file; see arithmetic_autointerp_rawfirings.json.
scoring: Each description was compared post-hoc against the code's ground-truth top label from arithmetic_r1r2.json. 'directional' means the description correctly characterised the code as either a specific arithmetic-condition detector or a positional/generic code, matching what the purity table shows.

results.description: Fires almost exclusively on one specific per-digit carry/borrow category (78% purity, 6.2x lift) and is tightly localized to the d1 answer position, indicating a genuine single-event marker (e.g. a carry-generating or sum-to-9 propagation column) rather than a generic position tag.
results.note: Named sum-to-9 propagation. US is by definition a carry cascade through a sum-9 run, so this matches. Caveat: sum-9 was one of the listed candidates.

results.description: Fires only at position d1 and is moderately concentrated on one carry-related category (44% purity, 4.1x lift), suggesting a d1-specific carry/borrow marker, though less exclusively single-category than t6.
results.note: Correct family (borrow consumption) without naming the exact label.

results.description: Also confined to position d1 with a mild skew toward one carry category (37% purity, 2.2x lift), consistent with a weaker or partially overlapping d1 carry-state signal.

The largest code by far (n=5200) with only a slight bias toward one category and toward the overflow position d0, but purity is close to base rate - no clear single carry-category pattern, more like a generic/default column code.
results.note: Correctly declined to invent a specialist story for a near-chance code.

results.description: Fires exclusively at answer position d3 in every occurrence, but shows little preference for any particular carry/borrow category, indicating it marks the d3 digit position itself rather than a specific arithmetic event.
results.note: Correctly identified as positional rather than semantic.

results.description: Fires exclusively at answer position d4 with weak category concentration, indicating a positional marker for the d4 digit rather than a carry/borrow-specific signal.
results.note: Correctly identified as positional rather than semantic.

summary.negative_control: The interpreter labelled every near-chance code (lift 1.5-1.6) as positional or generic rather than inventing a specialist story for it. This is the control that makes the code-6 identification meaningful: the same procedure declined to produce a finding where there was none.
